articles.title: Mattel shares rise after reports of takeover interest from Authentic Brands Group
articles.description: Shares of toymaker Mattel rose Thursday after the Wall Street Journal reported that Authentic Brands Group had expressed interest in buying the toymaker.

articles.title: Nike shares plummet 10% after weak revenue outlook and layoff plans underway
articles.description: Nike's shares plummeted in premarket trading, continuing a second straight day of declines after it reported falling revenue and plans to lay off staff.

articles.title: How AI is redefining Wall Street jobs — and boosting demand for this new 'hottest skill' by 1,721%
articles.description: Banks are fueling a hiring surge for AI engineers who are good at "agent orchestration" — the ability to coordinate teams of specialized agents.

articles.title: YouTube sports strategy targets more live rights -- but not necessarily events
articles.description: YouTube is targeting more live sports rights. But it's more likely to buy games in bulk if there's a clear consumer proposition underlying the rights.

articles.title: Democratic Texas AG candidate vows to probe Deloitte's role in voter registration delay
articles.description: Texas is working through a backlog of nearly 200,000 unprocessed voter registration applications, thanks to a software error involving state contractor Deloitte.

articles.title: Eurozone inflation hits its highest level in three years at 3.8% as energy costs soar
articles.description: Annual euro zone inflation hit 3.8% last month, its highest level since September 2023.

articles.title: Bitcoin reaches for $87K as short liquidations top $120M

articles.title: Oil prices fall over 3% on report of potential diesel, crude stock release; Brent back below $100
articles.description: It comes after Reuters reported that EU nations were discussing a proposal to release diesel reserves following pressure from the Trump administration.

articles.title: Aave founder says V3 unaffected after third-party adapter exploit drains $305K
articles.description: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Aave v3 was unaffected after an attacker exploited a third-party adapter to drain about $305,000 from two Safe multisig wallets.

articles.title: Brazil votes in high-stakes election as U.S.-China rivalry and debt loom large

articles.title: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin this month over a decade after debut there
